sloka: नाना द्रुम विकीर्णेषु धातु निष्पन्द शोभिषु ।एतानि मम वेगम् हि शिखराणि महान्ति च ॥४-६७-३८॥
transliteration: nānā druma vikīrṇeṣu dhātu niṣpanda śobhiṣu ।etāni mama vegam hi śikharāṇi mahānti ca ॥4-67-38॥

translations.english: 'I will pick up speed on the peaks of mount Mahendra filled with different kinds of trees and minerals.
